// Fixture — should NOT be flagged.
//
// The exported *Service method has the //nolint:serviceingress
// pragma in its doc comment with a rationale. Used when PathJoin
// is being assembled from caller-internal constants only and the
// `string` param does not flow into the path.

package fixture

type Result struct {
	OK bool
}

type Service struct{}

func PathJoin(parts ...string) string {
	out := ""
	for _, p := range parts {
		out += p + "/"
	}
	return out
}

// RotateInternal rebuilds the segment index from an internal
// constant prefix; the `kind` string param classifies the
// caller but does not reach PathJoin.
//
//nolint:serviceingress — caller-internal prefix, no UI ingress
func (s *Service) RotateInternal(kind string) Result {
	_ = kind
	path := PathJoin("/internal", "segments")
	_ = path
	return Result{OK: true}
}
